final_response: I have successfully followed up on the customer data export incident. I've sent an email to Riley Stone (riley@client.com) requesting the missing diagnostic information including error logs, timestamps, specific data sets that failed, configuration details, and system environment information. I've also documented this follow-up in the customer incident ticket (T-ct-a-CT_AB_2_003).

args.body:
Dear Riley,

I'm following up on the data export incident that was recently reported. To help us investigate and resolve this issue promptly, we need some additional diagnostic information that appears to be missing from the initial report.

Could you please provide the following:

1. Detailed error messages or logs from the data export process
2. Timestamps of when the export failures occurred
3. Specific data sets or tables that failed to export
4. Any configuration files or settings related to the export
5. System environment details (OS version, database version, etc.)

If there are any relevant screenshots or additional context that would help us understand the issue better, please include those as well.

Please send this information at your earliest convenience so we can begin troubleshooting.

Best regards,
Support Team
args.subject: Follow-up: Data Export Incident - Missing Diagnostics Request

args.comment: Followed up with customer (Riley Stone) via email requesting missing diagnostics for the data export incident. Asked for error logs, timestamps, specific data sets that failed, configuration details, and system environment information.
